summary: NewGenIVF Group Limited, a Thai foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing share issuances under strategic share purchase agreements to acquire a 3% equity interest in K25.ai. Outstanding Class A shares total 5,919,948; no price per share or premium disclosed. Based on July 30, 2026, closing price of $0.85, market value of listed securities reached $5,031,956. The board chairman signed the report. No advisors named. Watch for further terms of the K25.ai acquisition and potential dilution effects on existing shareholders.
